sqlquery.from:
(select count(task.id) as zid, task.id, max(task.name) as taskname, max(pj.name) as projectname, max((mu.firstName||' '||mu.lastname)) as assignee , max((ma.firstname ||' '|| ma.lastname)) as manager, max((bma.firstname ||' '|| bma.lastname)) as backmanager, max(task.startdate) as startdate, max(task.duedate) as duedate, max(ts.totaltime) as totalhours, max(ats.approvedtotaltime) as approvedtotaltime, max(task.percent) as percent, (CASE WHEN task.all_day is not null THEN (CASE WHEN task.all_day = true THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END) ELSE 'no' END) as allday from "$".task task left join "$".project pj on task.projectid = pj.id left join "$".reference ref on task.statusid = ref.id left join "$".employeetask emtk on emtk.taskid = task.id left join "$".projectemployee pjem on emtk.projectemployeeid = pjem.id left join "$".teamemployee tmem on pjem.employeedepartmentid = tmem.id left join "$".myuser mu on tmem.employeeid = mu.id left join "$".team tm on tm.id = tmem.teamid left join "$".myuser ma ON ma.id = pj.managerid left join "$".myuser bma on bma.id = pj.backup_managerid left join (select timesheet.taskid, sum(timesheet.timespent) as totaltime from "$".timesheet timesheet group by timesheet.taskid) ts on task.id = ts.taskid left join (select timesheet.taskid,sum(timesheet.timespent) as approvedtotaltime from "$".timesheet timesheet left join "$".reference ref on timesheet.statusid = ref.id where ref.code ='_APPROVE' group by timesheet.taskid) ats on task.id = ats.taskid
where ref.code not in ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') and task.deleted is not true and (task.isissue is null or task.isissue=false) and now() > task.duedate group by task.id ) t
